author: BPLC Team
description: 信号覆盖插件:全网节点在一张图上展示,每节点自带覆盖圈,圈内为其有向邻居(发现列表声称能听到的,TEI1 能听到 TEI2 不代表反向);邻居按信号强度/发现帧数由近及远排序。节点颜色表示通信成功率。点击切换选中,滚轮缩放,拖拽平移,主题跟随主界面。
description_en: Signal coverage plugin: all nodes on one map, each with a coverage circle of its directed neighbors (from its own discover bitmap); neighbors sorted near-to-far by link rate / discover-frame count. Node colors show comm success rates. Click to recenter, wheel to zoom, drag to pan, theme follows the host.
name: cpp-coverage
